summary: Stop parent-email MIME traversal at attachment boundaries so attached-message bodies and descendants cannot alter parent evidence, inventory or workflow role.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and email content
Confirmed synthetic reproduction where a message/rfc822 attachment changed its parent RFI response role to MIXED
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued email and workflow adaptability improvements.
known_limitations: Only explicit attachment disposition or filename boundaries are treated as selectable attachments, matching the existing inspection workflow.
MSG, mailbox synchronization, automatic attachment recursion and semantic thread inference remain unsupported.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no mailbox, model or external provider request is used.
